name: Water Girl
source:
Mizu wants to find the sorcerer that cursed her with water. The only problem is she can't do it on her own. Can she convince her savior to lend her a hand?

[From [url=https://florelle-blu.itch.io/water-girl]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
美津想要找到用水诅咒她的巫师。唯一的问题是她无法独自完成这件事。她能说服她的救世主向她伸出援助之手吗？

[来自[url=https://florelle-blu.itch.io/water-girl]itch.io[/url]]
